title: 缓存构建 CPU 预取（newbie_cache_build_prefetch）

standard.summary: 首轮缓存构建时在 CPU 线程预解码下一批图像，与 GPU
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: During the first-pass cache build, pre-decodes the next batch of images on a CPU thread, and with the GPU
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 首轮缓存构建时在 CPU 线程预解码下一批图像，与 GPU 编码重叠。仅批大小 > 1 时生效。

advanced_en.principle: During the first cache build, pre-decodes the next batch of images on CPU threads, overlapping with GPU encoding. Only effective when batch size > 1.
